$Comment: The skeleton every lesson on the Mastery Trainer's board (Mmo_Mastery_Lessons) inherits through
Requires keeps every lesson off a server with mastery switched off: the plain mmoskilltree:feature
condition at the top, with Min 1, hides the lesson rather than locking it. A lesson that writes its
own Requires replaces this one whole, so it would have to carry the feature condition too.
Rewards.Claim is what a Gathering, Fighting or Crafting lesson pays: a handful of Essence of Life
(Lootables/Mmo_Mastery_Lesson_Pay.json) and standing with the trainer (the Reputation reward;
Amount is how much). The pay waits at the board until the player collects it there. A Hard or
Master's lesson writes its own Claim list, which replaces this one whole, with more standing and,
for a Master's lesson, a mastery point.
A lesson names its board and band in Boards, its work in Objectives (always out in the world:
nothing in the Forgotten Temple can be broken or fought) and its words in Text.
